title: "2024-01-31" + 1 is 45323: the text converts to the date's day number and the sum is a number

source.quote: VALUE is not common because DAX implicitly converts text to numbers as necessary
source.supports: the implicit conversion is the one VALUE does, and VALUE ( "2020-10-23" ) is shown as 44127

source.quote: Any argument passed as a string to the binary operator is automatically converted into a number
source.supports: + converts a string operand to a number

derivation: + converts a string to a number as VALUE does. VALUE of an ISO date is its day number: 2020-10-23 is 44127. 2024-01-31 is 1195 days later (69 to the end of 2020, 365 + 365 + 365 for 2021 to 2023, 31 in January 2024), so 45322. Plus 1 is 45323.
alternative: If the text is cast to a date rather than a number, the addition table gives Date/time for Date/time + INTEGER and the result is the date 2024-02-01. If text in date form is not accepted by +, the query fails.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says whether a number that came from text is an integer or a decimal number.
